title: BiasTestGPT: Using ChatGPT for Social Bias Testing of Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language model probabilities on stereotype versus anti-stereotype sentence pairs generated by ChatGPT, using counterfactual substitution of male and female terms associated with attributes like professions, science/arts, and caregiving.

Evaluating language model probabilities on stereotype versus anti-stereotype sentence pairs generated by ChatGPT, using counterfactual substitution of European American, African American, and Hispanic terms associated with attributes like pleasantness, treatment adherence, and risky health behaviors.

Evaluating language model probabilities on stereotype versus anti-stereotype sentence pairs generated by ChatGPT, using counterfactual substitution of terms for minority females (African American, Mexican American) versus European American males.

Evaluating language model probabilities on stereotype versus anti-stereotype sentence pairs generated by ChatGPT, using counterfactual substitution of young versus old names, as well as infant versus adult terms associated with vaccination.

Evaluating language model probabilities on stereotype versus anti-stereotype sentence pairs generated by ChatGPT, using counterfactual substitution of mental versus physical health terms and attributes like temporary versus permanent.
